title: Creamy Zanzibari Sweetcorn Pilaf
description: A vibrant and aromatic Indian-inspired pilaf dish featuring sweetcorn, zanzibari, and a creamy twist.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add sweetcorn and cook until lightly browned (5 minutes).
Add pilaf and stir to combine with sweetcorn.
In a separate bowl, whisk together crème and 1 tsp of zanzibari.
Pour the crème mixture over the pilaf mixture and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in remaining 1 tsp of zanzibari.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped cilantro (optional).
